text:
The fastest land animal in the world is the cheetah.

Based on your travel history and preferences, I recommend visiting Zanzibar, Tanzania. You previously enjoyed a wildlife safari in Kenya, and Tanzania offers a similar, high-quality wildlife experience in the Serengeti or Ngorongoro Crater, where you can see cheetahs and other big game. Afterward, you can head to Zanzibar for beach relaxation. Zanzibar is also an excellent destination for bird watching, with over 500 species recorded, including many endemic and migratory birds, which will satisfy your partner's interest. This itinerary combines your love for wildlife, the need for beach downtime, and your partner's hobby.
